mapper.select:
SELECT -- Process p.id AS process_id, p.code AS process_code, p.name AS process_name, p.bussiness_key AS process_bussiness_key,
-- Rule r.id AS rule_id, r.type AS rule_type, r.process_definition_version AS process_definition_version, r.disabled AS disabled, r.is_default AS is_default, r.create_time AS rule_create_time, r.create_user_name AS rule_create_user_name, r.update_time AS rule_update_time, r.update_user_name AS rule_update_user_name,
CASE WHEN r.type = 'fsProcess' THEN tpd.name WHEN r.type = 'erpProcess' THEN pd.process_name ELSE NULL END AS process_definition_name,
-- Expression e.index AS exp_index, CONCAT( COALESCE(e.left_bracket, ''), COALESCE(e.field, ''), COALESCE(drc.value, ''), COALESCE(e.right_bracket, ''), COALESCE(e.logic, ''), COALESCE(e.name, '') ) AS exp_desc
FROM public.cfg_process p LEFT JOIN public.cfg_process_rule r ON p.id = r.cfg_process_id AND r.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.third_process_definition tpd ON r.type = 'fsProcess' AND r.process_definition_id = tpd.id AND tpd.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.process_definition pd ON r.type = 'erpProcess' AND r.process_definition_id = pd.id AND pd.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.cfg_process_exp e ON r.id = e.rule_id AND e.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.dict_rule_condition drc ON e.compare = drc.key AND drc.is_deleted = false
WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} AND p.is_deleted = false
${params.permissionSql}
ORDER BY r.create_time,p.code desc

SELECT p.id AS process_id, p.code AS process_code, p.name AS process_name, p.bussiness_key AS process_bussiness_key,
r.id AS rule_id, r.type AS rule_type, r.process_definition_version, r.disabled, r.is_default As is_default, r.create_time AS rule_create_time, r.create_user_name AS rule_create_user_name, r.update_time AS rule_update_time, r.update_user_name AS rule_update_user_name, CASE WHEN r.type = 'fsProcess' THEN tpd.name WHEN r.type = 'sysProcess' THEN pd.process_name ELSE NULL END AS process_definition_name,
CONCAT(e.left_bracket,e.field,drc.value,e.right_bracket,e.logic,e.name) AS expDesc, e.index AS exp_index
FROM public.cfg_process p LEFT JOIN public.cfg_process_rule r ON p.id = r.cfg_process_id AND r.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.third_process_definition tpd ON r.type = 'fsProcess' AND r.process_definition_id = tpd.id AND tpd.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.process_definition pd ON r.type = 'sysProcess' AND r.process_definition_id = pd.id AND pd.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.cfg_process_exp e ON r.id = e.rule_id AND e.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.dict_rule_condition drc ON e.compare = drc.key AND drc.is_deleted = false WHERE p.is_deleted = false AND p.id = #{id} ORDER BY r.create_time desc
